title: NativeScript Gradle facts
description: Written by the NativeScript CLI at prepare time to platforms/android/nativescript-gradle.json and read by org.nativescript:gradle-api. Fields are only ever added: readers must ignore unknown fields, and a field never changes meaning. Every path is relative to the directory containing this file and uses forward slashes.

schemaVersion.description: Bumped only when a field is added. Readers accept any version and read the fields they know.

dependenciesJson.description: The dependencies.json the CLI wrote next to this file, before this file. A CLI that does not write this file still rewrites dependencies.json but leaves this file behind, so readers ignore this file when dependencies.json no longer has this hash.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the exact bytes of dependencies.json.

capabilities.description: Behaviours the CLI that wrote this file guarantees. Lets readers tell 'not set' apart from 'this CLI does not know about it'.

root.description: The NativeScript project root (the folder with the app's package.json).

plugins.description: Every npm package with Android native code, in dependency order (a plugin comes after the plugins it depends on).

nativeDir.description: The directory Gradle reads the plugin's Android files from: the package's platforms/android, or the CLI's copy of it when node_modules is kept read-only.

aarName.description: File name, without extension, of the aar the CLI builds from the plugin's sources. Unique across the project.

aar.description: Where the CLI puts that aar. The file only exists if the plugin has sources to build.

dependencies.description: Names of the other entries in plugins that this plugin depends on.

options.description: Per-plugin options for the plugin's own Gradle code. Reserved; always empty for now.
